rules.early: current price below entry zone but above stop
rules.extended: 0-2% above entry high and still below target1
rules.chaseRisk: >2% above entry high or already at/above target1
rules.unknown: missing current price or entry zone

sectorCorrelationEngine.note: Sector constraints use controlled symbol mappings only. Correlation is Pearson correlation of overlapping daily close-to-close returns and is used as a concentration-control signal, not as a forecast.

sector.note: Sector contribution uses controlled symbol mappings only; unmapped symbols remain neutral.

missingValuePolicy.method: Renormalize only across available components, then apply explicit caps for missing critical/context inputs and low score coverage.

engineAgreementPolicy.rule: Distinct declared engine families only; family breadth is not a statistical independence claim.

forwardEvidencePolicy.reason: A single global forward score is non-discriminative and would add the same pseudo-evidence to every ticker. Forward evidence remains visible in calibration/outcome analytics and can only become ticker-specific probability after WP5 governance.

sensitivityPolicy.perturbation: Each available component weight is changed by -20% and +20% one at a time, then available weights are renormalized.

finalDecisionEngine.note: Final Decision Score is a missing-aware research ranking, not a probability of profit and not an execution instruction.

methodology.source: persisted contemporaneous replay sessions + recorded-forward prospective evidence only
methodology.optimizationPolicy: NO_PARAMETER_OPTIMIZATION_IN_V6.1; frozen model evaluated forward only
methodology.note: This engine intentionally refuses to reconstruct pre-V6 decisions from future-known data.

probabilityCalibrationEngine.methodology: Recorded-forward resolved evidence only. Maturity requires both resolved outcomes and distinct sessions. Estimates use hierarchical pooling from grade+entry+R:R+context toward broader pools. Confidence intervals use deterministic 90% session-block bootstrap. Probability fields remain null until >=90 resolved outcomes across >=30 distinct sessions AND the walk-forward calibration gate passes. Brier/ECE are computed only from ex-ante VALIDATED probabilities frozen at capture.

portfolioSelectionEngine.note: Research basket only. Per-name and low-liquidity caps are never exceeded; any unused allocation remains explicitly unallocated. Engine-family, sector and observed correlation controls reduce duplicate risk. Weights are research weights, not order sizes.

policy.riskFloorPolicy: NO_MINIMUM_FLOOR; risk factors may reduce sizing to zero

riskBudgetEngine.note: Theoretical size is preserved for plan analysis. Actionable size is forced to zero unless the latest monitoring state is IN_ENTRY_ZONE and the Decision Gate passes. Near-stop/critical setups can never display a positive actionable new-entry size.

monitoringAlertsEngine.note: Monitoring uses delayed/current-session data. Alerts are state-change research signals, not real-time execution triggers.

samplePolicy.t1Denominator: deduped activated records; ambiguous entry/OHLC cases remain descriptive and are excluded from return metrics

interpretation.expectancy: Average net return across resolved prospective records after resolver costs.
interpretation.profitFactor: Gross positive resolved returns divided by absolute gross negative resolved returns.
interpretation.t1ObservedPct: Share of activated records that have observed T1 or better; unresolved records remain in the denominator.
interpretation.caution: Small groups are descriptive only. No causal or calibrated-probability claim is made from subgroup rankings.

changeAttributionEngine.note: Attribution compares persisted prior-session factor snapshots; it explains observed ranking changes, not causal market effects.

coverage.rule: Only explicit DORMANT/SUSPENDED/DELISTED evidence removes a symbol from the denominator. ACTIVE_STALE and SOURCE_FAILED remain in it.

sources.currentUse: Provenance label on rows already present in the canonical upstream

sourcePolicy.dormantExclusionRule: A symbol may leave the active coverage denominator only with explicit instrument-status evidence. Staleness alone never makes a symbol dormant.
sourcePolicy.fallbackRule: Fallback may fill missing data only if its access terms permit automated use and its session/price checks pass.
sourcePolicy.safety: Data-source status never enables automatic execution.

trustArchitecture.note: True no-look-ahead replay is available only for sessions persisted after V6 Trust Archive activation. Earlier dates are not reconstructed from future-known data. Current same-session build differs from the already-frozen snapshot; the frozen record was preserved unchanged.

reliability.meaning: Operational and evidence reliability index; NOT probability of profit and NOT expected return.
reliability.hardCapRule: Atomic data-integrity failure or broken persisted ledger chain caps reliability below 50.
